text:
sara_support: Hey team — we have a customer ticket (C-11844) reporting a spike of 500s from the hosted API when they hit rate limits. They expect 429 but are seeing 500s and losing request bodies. They're on prod in us-west-2. Customer says this started ~10:32 PDT and is still intermittent. Any quick triage?

alex_eng: thanks sara. putting this on pager. initial glance: gateway traces show quota-orch returning 5xx instead of 4xx for a bunch of requests. Looks like downstream timeout to quota backend. grabbing logs now.

alerts-bot: [ALERT] quota-orch.service high 5xx rate (us-west-2) — 1,200/min — triggered at 2026-03-15T17:32:12Z — alert id: QORCH-2042 — link: https://infra-alerts/redwood/QORCH-2042

mike_oncall: repro attempt from my laptop (us-west):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"model":"gpt-x","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?customer_id=acct-549 
```
response headers: `x-redwood-quota: failed`, `x-redwood-error: rate_orch_unavailable`, status 500. body: `{"error":"quota service unavailable"}`

nina_sre: looks like quota-orch timed out to rate-store. I see a pattern: `timeout waiting for rate-store shard` in quota-orch logs. sample: 
```
2026-03-15T17:31:58.123Z ERROR quota-orch request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate upstream=rate-store-14 timeout=1.5s err="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T17:32:00.456Z WARN  quota-orch fallback=failed request_id=abc124 err="no fallback route"
```

alex_eng: interesting — why is quota-orch returning 500 instead of mapping to 429? There should be classifier that maps rate-store answers and timeouts into 4xx when quota exceeded or 503 fallback when upstream totally down. Could be recent change to fail-open policy. Checking recent deploys.

deploy-bot: deploy: quota-orch v2.14.3 deployed by jbranch at 2026-03-15T17:15:02Z — rollout 100% — changelog: "optimize shard selection, reduce coupling to legacy-store"

mike_oncall: correlating — deploy at 17:15, tickets at 17:32. pattern looks real. Queueing temporary mitigation: route traffic to quota-orch v2.14.1 or enable legacy fallback.

alex_eng: quick debug patch: increase quota-orch upstream timeout from 1.5s to 3s in staging and watch. If it's a transient latency spike hitting 1.5s bound, that could flip to 5xx on timeout. Also check the error classifier: code that transforms upstream errors to 4xx may be swallowing some error types after the new optimization.

sara_support: customer is asking for ETA and whether we can set a fallback so they don't get 500s — they're concerned about UI behavior and billing. marking as high CSAT risk.

nina_sre: snapshotting the offending logs and traces to the incident channel. Also see Redis cluster rebalancing events around 17:30 for shard-14: `reshard start` / `migrating keys` — could explain timeouts.

alex_eng: good catch — if rate-store shard is migrating, shard selection optimization might send requests to the moving node causing timeouts. That would then return an upstream timeout which quota-orch currently surfaces as 500. We need to map that to 429 or to a graceful fallback route.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigations I can apply now (need 👍 from eng):
- revert quota-orch to v2.14.1 in us-west-2 (safe rollback)
- OR flip `enable_shard_opt` = false via runtime config (hot reload)
- OR update gateway to treat `x-redwood-error: rate_orch_unavailable` as 429 for customer-facing behavior
Which should I do?

alex_eng: do runtime flip first (less blast radius). If that doesn't reduce 5xx in 10m, rollback. nina, can you flip `enable_shard_opt=false`? config path: `services/quota-orch/runtime.enable_shard_opt`

nina_sre: flipping now. patch: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" https://config-store/runtime -d '{"path":"services/quota-orch/runtime.enable_shard_opt","value":false}'
```
Done — change applied at 17:37:08Z. Watching metrics.

alerts-bot: [INFO] quota-orch 5xx rate dropping — 17:40:12Z — rate now 310/min (was 1200/min)

mike_oncall: customer reports degraded but not 500s anymore. sara: please confirm with customer and update ticket.

sara_support: reached out to customer: they confirm errors stopped ~17:42, UI recovered. They're still asking for root cause and we promised an incident follow-up. They asked about any billing impact — looks like some requests were retried client-side, not charged twice. Marking finance consult just in case.

alex_eng: next steps (action items):
- alex_eng to open a PR to harden quota-orch error classifier so upstream timeouts map to 429 when appropriate and add a metric guard (ETA 24h)
- nina_sre to investigate rate-store shard rebalancing cause and put guardrails to avoid migrations during peak deploy windows (ETA 48h)
- mike_oncall to prepare rollback playbook and add an automatic runtime toggle for `enable_shard_opt` (ETA 72h)
- sara_support to send customer-facing summary and CSAT mitigation note (ETA 2h)

nina_sre: I'll also add an alert rule to detect shard migration + quota-orch timeouts correlation and page earlier.

alex_eng: thanks all. leaving this thread open until postmortem doc is linked. Please add any logs/traces to the incident doc.

sara_support: doc link: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1768888888 (will post final summary here) :thumbsup:
